scope: For every spur of the jaw-fit pool: with that spur moved to the target point, which parts of the robot at the reference home pose are beneath the orchard's ground relief. Offline geometry; home pose only.

definitions.beneath: a vertical ray from the point meets the ground above it and none below it
definitions.parts: each link hull (surface samples), the tool point, the jaw mouth, the planner's home camera
definitions.home: the settled home of the reference recording, as the planner uses it
